acceptanceCriteria: A regression with a crafted map whose method name contains `); ...` produces no executable code outside the step callback.
Identifier names still produce the call unchanged.
body: Codex round-3 P2 on the gh660 lane (issue 660, V1-0959, branch claude/gh660 e7349d77), 2026-10-07, Core 1.0.0-rc.2. internal/appmap/plan.go (~line 1114) formats `await %s.%s();` with me.Name taken from the map. A real scan cannot produce a non-identifier (the gh657 methodLine regex captures identifiers only), but a hand-edited or foreign map can carry a name that closes the test.fixme callbacks and yields module-level code in the draft. Expected: only a JavaScript identifier is emitted as a call; anything else is emitted commented out and reported.
title: map_plan draft skeleton inserts a map method name unquoted into generated test code
